name: claude-adversarial-review
description: Independent Claude adversarial reviews with scoped source inspection and structured findings.

interface.shortDescription: Independent Claude reviews of code and design.
interface.longDescription: Independent reviews through your installed Claude Code CLI. An approved host launch runs the Python runner, Git collection, and Claude's main process outside Codex's sandbox. Bash is sandboxed by default; only a declared originally full-access task may explicitly disable it, losing OS filesystem/network enforcement. Read-only command and tool rules remain. Read, Glob, and Grep use application permission checks. Installation grants no host access; native authorization still applies. The runner records but cannot verify the original host-mode declaration.
interface.defaultPrompt: Review my changes with Claude, focusing on security, performance, and correctness.
